mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with aripiprazole (dopamine partial agonist) increases risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis due to inhibition of monoamine oxidase and potential sympathomimetic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, phenelzine should be discontinued at least 14 days before starting aripiprazole, and aripiprazole at least 2 weeks before starting phenelzine, with close monitoring for hypertension and serotonergic adverse effects.
